correctness.rationale: Induction on standard ordered-pair 2-WL signatures establishes the clipped outer gap threshold A_r=2^r-1 and middle B_r=2^r: splitting positions z among the three intervals recovers boundary unsaturated runs, doubles their reachable lengths, while saturated multiplicity cannot reveal further splits beyond total gap N-1. At r=floor(log2(n-1)), fixed total and the clipped profile identify full reflection orbits and stabilize; the diagonal near-endpoint thresholds force strictness one prior round. Independently implemented multiset WL, class-equivalence and clipped profile for ALL rounds and every n<=14, exactly matching depth and every pair color class. The n<=2 boundary was checked. The finite test is not a substitute for induction.
